verdict.rationale: OpenHands exposes a documented OpenAPI spec and dedicated 'API support for automation and scripting' tier, plus CLI mode with resume/auto-approve that mirrors UI conversation flows, suggesting broad API parity. However, no evidence explicitly confirms that every UI feature (e.g., cloud dashboard views, integrations config, enterprise SSO management) is fully API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation enumerating UI vs API feature coverage, and independent/hands-on confirmation that API can replicate all UI workflows.
